problem_statement: mazyar1128 tailwindcss-invoice-dashboard is a static, pre-compiled Tailwind invoice management dashboard (Lozeq): a fixed sidebar (Dashboard/Transactions/Invoices/Expenses/Banking/Cards/Settings), a top nav with Preferences, Create New, and an avatar, a rose 'All Invoices' filter panel with Begin Date/End Date/Status/Client controls, and an invoice table listing Invoice #12 (John Doe, Draft), #13 (Thomas Bride, Paid), #14 (Ellen Bean, Draft), #15 (Jack Sanders, Paid), and #16 (Leslie Ive, Draft). A recent change added the dashboard's own 'Invoice status filter' bar directly above the invoice table — a row of All / Draft / Paid tabs plus a live 'Showing N of 5 · <status>' readout that narrows the table to the matching rows — and the same filter bar was meant to appear on the Transactions and Expenses pages that share the Lozeq shell. Three regressions slipped in and must be repaired together. (1) Layout: the tab row is a fixed-width, non-wrapping flex row, so on a 390px phone the whole dashboard scrolls sideways and the sidebar/nav/table drift off-screen (large horizontal overflow); the filter bar and the invoice rows it controls must reflow so the document fits the mobile viewport with no horizontal overflow, while the desktop and tablet layout stays a tidy single tab row over a legible, non-overlapping table. (2) Cross-page: the filter bar is missing from the Transactions and Expenses pages; it must be present on all three pages that share the shell. (3) Behaviour: the filter no longer works — clicking a status tab highlights the tab but the invoice rows and the 'Showing N of 5' readout stay frozen at 'Showing 5 of 5 · All invoices'; clicking Draft must narrow the table to the three Draft rows and update the readout to 'Showing 3 of 5 · Draft', and Paid likewise. Keep the exact invoice numbers, client names, amounts, dates, and status labels, the Lozeq sidebar/nav/avatar, and the All Invoices filter panel unchanged. Fix the filter bar's own layout rule (flex-wrap plus a flexible tab basis, not clipping or overflow-x:hidden masking), restore its presence across the shared pages, and repair the filter wiring so the shown rows and the count readout stay in sync with the active tab.
required_content: The 'Invoice status filter' bar (All / Draft / Paid tabs plus a 'Showing N of 5 · <status>' readout) sits directly above the invoice table on the Invoices page and reads as a tidy single tab row on desktop.

On a 390px mobile viewport the invoice dashboard has no horizontal document overflow: the sidebar toggle, nav, filter panel, status filter bar, and invoice table all stay within the viewport and the filter tabs reflow rather than being clipped or hidden.
The same status filter bar is present on the Transactions and Expenses pages that share the Lozeq shell, not only on the Invoices page.

Clicking the Draft tab narrows the invoice table to the three Draft rows and updates the readout to 'Showing 3 of 5 · Draft'; clicking All restores 'Showing 5 of 5 · All invoices'. The shown rows and the count stay in sync with the active tab.

The existing Lozeq sidebar, Preferences/Create New nav, avatar, All Invoices filters, and the Invoice #12–#16 rows (numbers, client names, amounts, dates, status labels) remain present and unmodified, and the dashboard runs with no new console errors or failed network requests.
design_constraints: Use the existing Tailwind utility style — white cards, indigo controls, rose Draft accent, rounded panels, compact dashboard spacing; the filter bar and its table must read as an operational dashboard control, not a marketing banner, and must stay legible (no dark-on-dark or near-white-on-near-white text).

Fix the overflow inside the filter bar's own layout rule; do not edit the invoice table rows, the All Invoices filter panel, the sidebar, or the nav markup, and do not change the invoice amounts, client names, dates, status labels, or table row order.

Do not remove, hide, or truncate the filter bar or its tabs to make the overflow go away, and do not overlap the invoice rows under the bar; the tabs must reflow responsively and the table must stay a legible list of non-overlapping rows.

Do not mask the overflow with overflow-x:hidden on the tab row or an ancestor — the document itself must not overflow the 390px mobile viewport, while the original wide dashboard/table behaviour is preserved at desktop and tablet widths.

The status filter must be wired so the active tab, the visible rows, and the 'Showing N of 5' readout stay consistent; a tab that only toggles its highlight while the rows and count stay frozen is not acceptable.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and tablet_initial capture the Invoices page with the status filter bar as a tidy single row of All/Draft/Paid tabs above the invoice table, with no horizontal overflow on desktop.

mobile_initial and mobile_filterbar capture the Invoices page at 390px; in the unrepaired defect the fixed-width non-wrapping tab row forces a large horizontal overflow, whereas the repaired bar reflows its tabs and the document fits the viewport.
desktop_filters scrolls to the All Invoices filter panel and confirms the Begin Date/End Date/Status/Client controls remain intact alongside the status filter bar.

desktop_filterbar scrolls to the status filter bar and confirms the All/Draft/Paid tabs and the 'Showing 5 of 5 · All invoices' readout render as one legible row above a tidy, non-overlapping invoice table.
desktop_transactions and desktop_expenses confirm the same status filter bar is present on the Transactions and Expenses pages that share the Lozeq shell.
mobile_transactions captures the Transactions page at 390px so the mobile no-overflow fix must hold on the shared pages too.
desktop_filter_draft clicks the Draft tab and confirms the invoice table narrows to the three Draft rows and the readout updates to 'Showing 3 of 5 · Draft'.

Source inspection confirms the site is a static, pre-compiled Tailwind template served directly; the status filter bar markup is identical across legs and its layout, cross-page presence, and wiring are driven by the invfilter-style block, the per-page bar markup, and the invfilter-js script.

change_completion: The Invoice status filter bar and its All/Draft/Paid tabs are present above the invoice table and appear on the Invoices, Transactions, and Expenses pages.
Clicking Draft narrows the table to the three Draft rows and the readout reads 'Showing 3 of 5 · Draft'; the shown rows and the count stay in sync with the active tab.
The invoice rows, client names, amounts, dates, and status labels and the surrounding Lozeq dashboard remain intact.
design_consistency: The filter bar uses the existing Tailwind dashboard style (white card, indigo/rose accents, rounded pills) and stays legible with adequate contrast on every captured state.
The filter bar and the invoice table it controls read as one coherent, non-overlapping region on desktop and tablet, consistent across the shared pages.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the whole dashboard, including the filter tab row, has no horizontal overflow beyond a small tolerance.
The filter tabs reflow (wrap on a flexible basis) on mobile rather than being clipped, hidden, or masked with overflow-x:hidden.
regression: The sidebar, nav, avatar, All Invoices filter panel, and the Invoice #12–#16 table rows remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.

levers.D6_no_horizontal_overflow: status filter tab row overflows 390px mobile in the unrepaired/bad legs; reference wraps to 0
levers.D3_visual_regression: bad leg collapses the filter bar + invoice table into an overlapping dark-on-dark illegible pile on desktop_filterbar and mobile_filterbar
levers.D2_dom_assertions: status filter bar present on Invoices + Transactions + Expenses; baseline renders it only on Invoices, bad forgets Expenses
levers.D4_interaction_assertions: clicking Draft updates rows + readout to 'Showing 3 of 5 · Draft'; bad freezes at 'Showing 5 of 5 · All invoices'
